Hi Aditya,

Thanks for the demo last week — Zenith is happy with the perf numbers so far. We need to schedule a technical deep-dive focusing on data protection for our security and compliance team. Primary scopes: SOC 2 evidence mapping, encryption (at-rest / in-transit / KMS), audit log formats & retention, and SSO / SCIM integration.

Week of Aug 2 works for us; do you have 60–90 minute slots that include a short walkthrough of the evidence checklist and a plan for next steps (evidence handoff + any outstanding artifacts)?

I've attached a preliminary questionnaire to speed things up: zenith-prelim-questionnaire.pdf

Appreciate it —
